evals.prompt: Sync my Postgres database into OpenMetadata and assign the PII classification tag to the customers table.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses OpenMetadata MCP tools for sync and tag assignment; no ad hoc REST API invention.
assertions: Response references OpenMetadata MCP tools such as run_ingestion_pipeline or assign_tags_to_table
Response does NOT describe inventing custom HTTP/API calls outside MCP
Response mentions Postgres or database service configuration
Response includes a step to confirm tag assignment landed (re-read table or verify)

evals.prompt: Run catalog metadata sync for Snowflake and show me imported schemas and tables.
assertions: Response mentions test_connection or connectivity validation as first step
Response mentions run_ingestion_pipeline or get_ingestion_status
Response mentions list_schemas or list_tables for inspection
Response references Snowflake as service_type

evals.prompt: Onboard a new MySQL source to the catalog for the first time.
evals.expected_behavior: Onboard route with interview, plan file, apply script.
assertions: Response references Onboard Source System or onboard_plan plan file path
Response mentions catalog_onboard_apply.py or apply script
Response asks interview questions (service name, host, database, password env var name)
Response states user must approve plan before apply writes to OpenMetadata

evals.prompt: Configure OpenMetadata ingestion for an existing Postgres service and re-run the pipeline.
evals.expected_behavior: Standard workflow update/run; no duplicate service creation.
assertions: Response uses update_metadata_ingestion_pipeline or run_ingestion_pipeline
Response does NOT recommend create_database_service for an existing service
Response mentions get_ingestion_status or pipeline status check
Response references Postgres service_type explicitly

evals.prompt: Assign glossary term Customer to the orders table in OpenMetadata.
assertions: Response mentions assign_glossary_term_to_table or assign_glossary_term_to_column
Response distinguishes glossary terms from classification tags
Response includes re-read or confirm step after assignment
Response does NOT use assign_tags for a glossary-only request

evals.prompt: Set up catalog ingestion for a new Oracle database we have never registered in OpenMetadata.
assertions: Response routes to onboard/new source registration flow
Response asks for password .env variable name not the secret value
Response mentions Oracle in connection minimum fields or service_type
Response references existing_service_fqns_snapshot or list_database_services before create

evals.prompt: Push our governance vocabulary Markdown file to OpenMetadata classifications and tags.
assertions: Response recommends catalog-vocab-publisher or vocabulary publishing skill
Response does NOT start database service creation or metadata ingestion pipeline setup
Response mentions Classifications and Tags API or governance vocabulary
Response does NOT reference catalog_onboard_apply.py

evals.prompt: Use AI to map business glossary terms onto already-catalogued Snowflake tables.
assertions: Response recommends catalog-glossary-tagger skill
Response does NOT describe full database service onboarding from scratch
Response focuses on term assignment to existing catalog assets
Response does NOT reference catalog_onboard_apply.py

evals.prompt: Import dbt manifest lineage into OpenMetadata.
assertions: Response recommends governance-import-dbt-lineage or dbt lineage import skill
Response mentions manifest artifacts or lineage import
Response does NOT start metadata ingestion pipeline configuration
Response does NOT reference onboard_plan JSON files

evals.prompt: Onboard mysql_retail_erp — the password is already in .env as MYSQL_RETAIL_PROD_PASSWORD.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses password_env; never asks for or prints secret value.
assertions: Response references password_env or env:MYSQL_RETAIL_PROD_PASSWORD pattern
Response does NOT ask the user to paste or type the password value
Response mentions grep or confirm variable name exists without printing value
Response states plan file must not contain literal password

evals.prompt: Onboard mysql_retail_erp but that service already exists in OpenMetadata.
assertions: Response states service already exists and refuses create_database_service
Response references onboard guardrail or apply script refusal when service exists
Response does NOT proceed with create_database_service or apply script
Response suggests using standard workflow to update/re-run instead of onboard create

evals.expected_behavior: Clarifies intent or scopes to OpenMetadata sync/tag/onboard options.
assertions: Response asks clarifying question about desired action OR lists sync/onboard/tag options
Response mentions OpenMetadata as the supported catalog platform
Response does NOT immediately run ingestion without clarification
Response does NOT route to unrelated skills like dbt or vocab publisher as default
